_comment: Pterodactyl egg for VectoraCloud. Source and documentation: https://github.com/VectoDE/VectoraCloud/blob/main/docs/cloud/operations.md
name: VectoraCloud
author: vectode@users.noreply.github.com
description: VectoraCloud runs a complete Minecraft network (Velocity proxy, Paper and Fabric servers, Geyser for Bedrock) inside one server. Every port the network uses needs an allocation: the default one for Java, plus Bedrock (UDP) and, if enabled, the legacy proxy. Raise the Wings PID limit (default 512) before running several servers; see the documentation.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# VectoraCloud installer for Pterodactyl (runs in ghcr.io/pterodactyl/installers:alpine).
# Downloads VectoraCloud.jar from the GitHub release and checks it against the release's
# SHA256SUMS. The signature (cosign) and provenance can be checked by hand, see
# docs/cloud/operations.md.
set -eu

REPO="VectoDE/VectoraCloud"
VERSION="${VECTORA_VERSION:-latest}"

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "$VERSION" = "latest" ]; then
    # The newest release including pre-releases (0.x versions are pre-releases).
    TAG=$(curl -fsSL -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
        "https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/releases?per_page=20" \
        | jq -r '[.[] | select(.draft == false)][0].tag_name // empty')
else
    TAG="v${VERSION#v}"
fi
case "$TAG" in
    v[0-9]*) ;;
    *) echo "No VectoraCloud release found (version: ${VERSION})."; exit 1 ;;
esac
case "$TAG" in
    *[!0-9A-Za-z.+-]*) echo "Invalid version: ${TAG}"; exit 1 ;;
esac

BASE="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/download/${TAG}"
echo "Installing VectoraCloud ${TAG}"
rm -f VectoraCloud.jar.part SHA256SUMS.part
curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -o VectoraCloud.jar.part "${BASE}/VectoraCloud.jar"
curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -o SHA256SUMS.part "${BASE}/SHA256SUMS"

expected=$(awk '$2 == "VectoraCloud.jar" || $2 == "*VectoraCloud.jar" { print $1 }' SHA256SUMS.part)
actual=$(sha256sum VectoraCloud.jar.part | awk '{ print $1 }')
if [ -z "$expected" ] || [ "$expected" != "$actual" ]; then
    echo "SHA-256 of VectoraCloud.jar does not match SHA256SUMS (expected ${expected:-none}, got ${actual})."
    rm -f VectoraCloud.jar.part SHA256SUMS.part
    exit 1
fi

mv -f VectoraCloud.jar.part VectoraCloud.jar
mv -f SHA256SUMS.part SHA256SUMS
echo "$TAG" > .vectora-version

# Wings fills setup.yml from the egg variables before every start (config.files). Create the file
# once, so there is something to fill; a reinstall keeps the existing one and any keys added by hand
# (for example database.host for an external database).
if [ ! -f setup.yml ]; then
    printf 'schema-version: 1\neula: false\n' > setup.yml
fi
echo "VectoraCloud ${TAG} installed, SHA-256 ${actual}."

variables.name: VectoraCloud version
variables.description: Release to install: latest (newest release, including pre-releases) or a version such as 0.2.0. Takes effect on reinstall.

variables.name: Cloud heap
variables.description: Maximum heap of the cloud process itself, e.g. 512M. The Minecraft servers get their own heap from the group settings; all of it together must fit into the server's memory.

variables.name: Accept the Minecraft EULA
variables.description: true only if you accept the Minecraft EULA (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA). Without it the setup stops and no Minecraft server starts.

variables.name: Language
variables.description: Language of the cloud: en or de.

variables.name: Network name
variables.description: 1 to 32 letters, digits, space, '.', '_' or '-', with at least one letter. Only used for the first setup.

variables.name: Bedrock port
variables.description: Port for Bedrock players (Geyser, UDP). Must be an additional allocation of this server.

variables.name: Legacy proxy
variables.description: true starts a second proxy for Minecraft 1.8.8 clients on the legacy port.

variables.name: Legacy proxy port
variables.description: Port of the legacy proxy. Must be an additional allocation if the legacy proxy is on.

variables.name: Database mode
variables.description: managed (the cloud runs its own MariaDB in this server), external (a database from the panel; add host, port, name, user and password as described in the documentation) or h2 (embedded, no shared database). docker is not available on Pterodactyl.
